text: {"name":"parse_bt_packet_and_update_status","confidence":"medium","docstring":"When the alternate BT parsing flag is enabled, parses packet fields from the nested context and stores the parser result in both bytes of its status word; otherwise it may disable an MMIO interrupt.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"v3":"packet_state","v4":"parsed_status"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":20,"meaning":"Encoded packet header; bits 11–13 select the parser type and bits 0–6 provide another parser input."},{"offset":36,"meaning":"Status word updated with the parser result duplicated into both bytes."}]}
